mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (id, cate_name, create_time, update_time, blog_num) VALUES (#{id}, #{cateName}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{blogNum})
mapper.select: SELECT id, cate_name, create_time, update_time, blog_num FROM category ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, cate_name, create_time, update_time, blog_num FROM category WHERE cate_name = #{cateName} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM category WHERE cate_name = #{cateName}
